raw_request: Continue RouteCodex current project governance with old and new governance states separated; reset only legacy AppSDK governance/control state, verify and compile the current project, then continue ordinary development.
understood_objective: Isolate legacy AppSDK governance state, establish fresh governance for the current RouteCodex project, and unblock ordinary V4 plugin development without reusing legacy artifacts or hashes.
acceptance_criteria: Legacy AppSDK governance/control state is reset without deleting business source, protected history, runtime data, or other worker state.
The reset is idempotent and the second reset is a no-op.
appsdk verify and appsdk compile validate the fresh project governance structure.
Ordinary RouteCodex development can continue without review admission.
Release admission remains separate and lists missing real producers without fabricating evidence.
non_goals: Copy legacy Active or Protected artifacts.
Manually edit FreezeRecord, PromotionRecord, ReviewRecord, artifact hashes, receipts, binary SHA, compiler digest, or bundle identity.
assumptions: The user-authorized current project root is this clean owner worktree.
Release admission producers will be implemented only when preparing a release.
